BackstoryDef.title: outer sword disciple
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an outer disciple of the Formless Sword: a thousand cuts before breakfast and a thousand after, on a training yard swept by the disciples themselves. The masters never explained the forms; they waited for [PAWN_objective] to understand them.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of the sword mound
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended the Sword Mound, where the blades of every dead master rest point-down in the earth. Polishing them one by one, [PAWN_pronoun] learned their names, their owners and the duels each one had lost.

BackstoryDef.title: inner sword bearer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an inner disciple, allowed to carry a sword outside the gate. The Formless Sword gives that right only to those who have stopped looking at the blade when they cut.

BackstoryDef.title: blade sent down the mountain
BackstoryDef.description: After the Convergence the sect sent [PAWN_nameDef] down the mountain with one order: find out what intent is worth in a world of guns and machines. [PAWN_pronoun] has walked the Rim since, fighting rarely and watching a lot.

BackstoryDef.title: core blade of the formless sword
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a core disciple, one of the few who may challenge an elder. The sect has apprentices to plant, haul and cook; [PAWN_pronoun] spent those years cutting falling leaves in two without touching the branch.

BackstoryDef.title: rival of the young master
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] won three sect tournaments and lost the fourth to Yan Zhao, the arrogant prodigy of the Formless Sword. Since that day [PAWN_pronoun] has trained twice as hard, and the whole sect is waiting for the fifth.

BackstoryDef.title: sword elder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an elder of the Formless Sword, trained in the line of Shen Ruoxue, whose sword is as cold as ice. Elders no longer prove anything with the blade; they teach with it, and the disciples say [PAWN_possessive] silence corrects more than words.

BackstoryDef.title: elder of discipline
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served under Gu Hengyue, the inflexible Elder of Discipline, and carried out the sect's punishments in [PAWN_possessive] name. Disciples lower their eyes when [PAWN_pronoun] passes; the sect master, Lin Wuchen, says that is exactly what the office is for.

BackstoryDef.title: swordsmith of the formless sword
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works the forge that once turned the shells of fallen machines into the Swords of the Broken Sky. Now [PAWN_pronoun] travels with the sect's caravans, selling blades and buying any metal the Rim has to offer.
